definition: A vertical structure that divides an enclosed space or separates two areas.

name: war
definition: A state of large-scale, organized armed conflict between different nations, countries, or political groups.

name: to be warm
definition: To have a temperature that is higher than cold but lower than hot.

name: to bathe
definition: To wash or clean the whole body with water.
burmese: ရေချိုးသည်

name: to wash (general)
definition: To remove dirt, soap, or impurities from an object or a person using water.
burmese: ဆေးကြောသည်

name: to wash clothes
definition: To clean garments or pieces of fabric using water and a cleaning agent.

name: to wash face
definition: To apply water to the face to clean it.

name: to wash hair
definition: To clean the hair on a person's head with water and soap or other cleansing agents.

name: wasp
definition: A stinging insect with a narrow waist, often living in a colony or nest.
burmese: နကျယ်ကောင်

name: to watch
definition: To look at something or someone for a period of time with your eyes.
burmese: စောင့်ကြည့်သည်

name: water
definition: The clear, colorless liquid that falls from the sky as rain and is necessary for all living things to drink.

name: drinking water
definition: The liquid that is necessary for life and is used for drinking, washing, and cooking.

name: to wave
definition: To move a hand or an arm repeatedly in the air, often as a greeting or to get someone's attention.

name: wax (from bee)
definition: A substance produced by bees in a honeycomb to build their nests.

name: to be weak
definition: To lack physical strength or power.
burmese: အားနည်းသည်

name: to wear (of clothes)
definition: To have a piece of clothing or an accessory on one's body.
burmese: အင်္ကျီဝတ်သည်

name: to wear (of hat)
definition: To have a piece of headgear on one's head.
burmese: ဦးထုပ်ဆောင်းသည်

name: to weave (baskets)
definition: To make a container or basket by interlacing strips of wood, bamboo, or other flexible materials.
burmese: ခြင်းရက်သည်

name: to weave (fabric)
definition: To make cloth or fabric by interlacing threads or fibers on a loom.
burmese: ရက်ကန်းရက်သည်

name: weed
definition: A plant that grows where it is not wanted, especially among crops or in a garden.

name: week
definition: A period of seven consecutive days.

name: to weep (cry)
definition: To shed tears from the eyes, often as an expression of sadness, pain, or grief.

name: to be well lit
definition: To have a lot of light or to be brightly illuminated.
burmese: အလင်းရောင်ကောင်းသည်

name: west
definition: The direction where the sun sets in the evening.

name: to be wet
definition: To be covered or soaked with a liquid, such as water.

name: to whistle
definition: To make a high-pitched sound by forcing air through the lips or teeth.
burmese: လေချွန်သည်

name: whole (complete)
definition: The entire amount or all of a single thing, without any parts missing or left over.
burmese: အပြည့်အစုံ

name: to be wicked (cruel)
definition: To act in a way that is harmful, hurtful, or morally wrong toward others.

name: to ve wide (broad)
definition: To have a large distance from one side to the other.

name: widow
definition: A woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

name: widower
definition: A man whose spouse has died.

name: wife
definition: A female partner in a marriage or a long-term committed relationship.

name: wind
definition: The natural movement of air caused by differences in atmospheric pressure.

name: wing
definition: The part of a bird, insect, or bat used for flying, consisting of a limb or membrane attached to the body.

name: to winnow
definition: To blow air through a mixture of grain and husks to separate the edible part from the waste.

name: winter (cold season)
definition: The coldest season of the year, occurring between autumn and spring.
burmese: ဆောင်းရာသီ

name: to wipe
definition: To move a cloth, hand, or other tool across a surface to remove dirt, liquid, or dust.

name: to be wise
definition: To possess or show great intelligence, good judgment, and deep understanding.

name: old woman
definition: An elderly female person.

name: woman (female human)
definition: An adult female human being.

name: wood
definition: The hard, fibrous material that forms the stem or trunk of a tree or shrub.

name: woodpecker (general)
definition: A bird with a strong, pointed beak that repeatedly strikes the trunks of trees to find insects.
burmese: သစ်တောက်ငှက်

name: word
definition: A single unit of speech or writing that has a specific meaning.

name: to work
definition: To engage in physical or mental effort to achieve a goal or earn a living.
burmese: အလုပ်လုပ်သည်

name: world (metaphysical)
definition: The totality of all existence, including all things that are real, both physical and non-physical.

name: worm (general)
definition: An elongated, soft-bodied animal that crawls on or through the ground.

name: to wrap (cloth)
definition: To encircle or cover an object by folding or winding a piece of fabric around it.
burmese: ထွေးပတ်သည်

name: wristband
definition: A strip of cloth, plastic, or leather worn around the wrist as an ornament or to identify a person.

name: to yawn
definition: To open the mouth wide and inhale deeply, often due to tiredness or boredom.

name: year
definition: A single period of time that it takes for the earth to orbit around the sun.

name: last year
definition: The year that has just finished or the one immediately preceding the current one.

name: next year
definition: The year that follows the current one.

name: this year
definition: The current twelve-month period that is happening now.

name: yeast
definition: A microscopic fungus used to make bread rise or to produce fermented drinks like beer or wine.

name: yesterday
definition: The day before today.
